articles.title_zh: ウクライナとポーランド、ロシアの国境攻撃を非難 ワルシャワ行き列車が被弾
facts_zh:
ウクライナとポーランド、ロシアの国境攻撃を非難 ワルシャワ行き列車が被弾
このニュースをシェア
【9月14日 AFP】ポーランドとウクライナは13日、両国国境付近でのロシアによる攻撃について、ワルシャワ行きの列車や国境検問所付近への攻撃を含め、戦争の「激化」であるとして非難した。
ロシアは同日、ウクライナ西部にドローン攻撃を行った。ウクライナ鉄道は、列車が攻撃を受けた時間帯に、ボリス・ジョンソン元英首相やデビッド・ペトレアス元米中央情報局（CIA）長官が近くの国境駅に滞在していたと発表した。
この数日前には、第2次世界大戦以降の欧州で最悪の紛争を終わらせるために、米特使がモスクワとキーウを訪問したばかりだった。一方で欧州諸国は、自国領域内でロシアが主導しているとされる不審な破壊工作が増加していることに懸念を強めている。

articles.title_zh: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
facts_zh:
Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
- Published
US President Donald Trump announced he will lift all tariffs on Irish whiskey at the end of his two-day visit to Ireland.
He made the announcement before handing over the winner's trophy at the Trump International golf resort in Doonbeg, Co Clare, to Irish Open winner Shane Lowry.
Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US, while whiskey made in Northern Ireland or elsewhere in the UK has no tariff.

A Russian drone has hit a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through.
No casualties were reported after the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine.
All the passengers had been evacuated, Ukrainian authorities said.

articles.title_zh: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
facts_zh:
Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
- Published
US President Donald Trump has downplayed risks posed by artificial intelligence following days of dire warnings by experts.
"You have a lot of very negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up and they're bringing up things that won't happen," Trump said during a visit to Ireland.
One of the warnings came from a former Anthropic researcher who said "there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future" if the current pace of development continued.

There has been no shortage of warnings from AI's top bosses about existential threats over the years.
I attended the world's first AI safety summit in Bletchley Park in November 2023 where the focus was on the most serious threats imaginable, posed by the most powerful AI models.

articles.title_original: Ukraine-Krieg: Moskau greift Zug an – Waren Diplomaten das Ziel?
articles.title_zh: Ukraine-Krieg: Moskau greift Zug an – Waren Diplomaten das Ziel?
facts_zh: Das russische Militär hat einen Personenzug in der ukrainischen Grenzregion zu Polen mit einer Kampfdrohne angegriffen und damit für Verstimmung in Warschau gesorgt.

Die polnische Regierung warf Moskau eine Verschärfung des Konflikts vor, später sorgte die ukrainische Bahngesellschaft für Aufsehen, als sie spekulierte, dass möglicherweise ein anderer, mit westlichen Diplomaten besetzter Zug, das Ziel des Angriffs war.

«Die Eskalation von russischer Seite ist nun Realität geworden, und die Beispiele dafür rücken immer näher an unsere Grenze heran», sagte Polens Regierungschef Donald Tusk bei einer Sitzung des Krisenstabs.

all_titles.de: Ukraine-Krieg: Moskau greift Zug an – Waren Diplomaten das Ziel?

articles.title_original: 华府智库建议美军“不介入”台海，赖清德当局连一个字都不敢回应
articles.title_zh: 华府智库建议美军“不介入”台海，赖清德当局连一个字都不敢回应
facts_zh: 华府智库“国防重点”最新一项有关“美军不应介入台海冲突”的建议，把“台独”势力吓哑了。几天过去，赖清德当局连一个字都不敢回应。

建议“不干预”台海并撤离人员
9月10日，“国防重点”智库军事分析主任卡瓦纳发布题为《亚洲第二岛链战略》的报告，提出美国亚太军事战略变革方案，该方案核心目标是在最大程度维护美国国家利益的同时，极小化与中国大陆爆发军事冲突的风险。言外之意，是向美国政府建言，美国在西太平洋的军事布局，到了该翻篇的时候了。
报告强调，美国在亚洲真正的核心利益仅有两项：一是防御美国本土免受直接威胁，二是确保进入关键经济市场与主要海上贸易航线的自由通行。为了实现这两项利益，华府无需维持庞大的前沿军事存在，更不应承担拖累自身，以避免陷入大国冲突的过度防务义务。

all_titles.zh: 华府智库建议美军“不介入”台海，赖清德当局连一个字都不敢回应

US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake
- Published
Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany has said he sustained minor injuries after a plane he was on landed on a lake, forcing him and the pilot to swim to safety.

Tiffany, the state's Republican nominee for governor, was travelling in a small plane on Saturday night when the aircraft encountered a mechanical issue, forcing the pilot to make an emergency landing in Lake Wausau, the county sheriff's office said.
Tiffany said he and the pilot called 911 once they landed.

articles.title_zh: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
facts_zh:
Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
- Published
Police in Turkey have detained 47 people in a series of raids on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ+ activists, officials say.
Raids took place in 12 provinces over the weekend as part of a campaign dubbed "My Family is Safe" that the Turkish government says has been designed to protect family values.
One of the targets of the operation was LGBTQ+ association Kaos GL.

all_titles.en: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists

articles.title_original: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
articles.title_zh: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
facts_zh:
Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
- Published
Six people have died and 107 have been rescued from a capsized Indonesian passenger ferry in the Java Sea, authorities have said.
Another 130 people are still missing after contact was lost with the Virgo Transport8 ship, as it encountered bad weather.

The ferry was travelling from Surabaya to the South Kalimantan city of Banjarmasin and was last reported to be about 150km (93 miles) south of Banjarmasin around 02:00 on Sunday (18:00 GMT on Saturday).

all_titles.en: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
